rules.statement: All sequential logic and FIFO clock/reset pins use the shared i_clk_core and i_rst_n_core.
The combinational AXI adapter uses i_rst_n_core only to suppress AXI VALID/READY during reset.
The top port list contains no AHB or AXI USER sideband signals.
The five FIFO instances have depths 2, 16, 2, 2 and 2 entries respectively, with software-reset inactive and both clock/reset pins tied to shared inputs.
The design contains no clock-domain crossing or CDC synchronizer.
The bridge issues ARLEN=0 and ARBURST=INCR, accepts one R beat with RLAST=1, and returns HRDATA and HRESP in the AHB data phase.

rules.condition: While the current AHB read is unresolved
rules.statement: The bridge must not accept the next AHB read while the current read is unresolved.

rules.condition: Write single, undefined INCR, or non-bufferable fixed burst beat
rules.statement: Issue one AXI write with AWLEN=0, one W beat with WLAST=1, wait for the B response, then return AHB completion/error.
Fixed non-bufferable bursts are serialized beat by beat.

rules.condition: Eligible Normal Write-back fixed write burst
rules.statement: Collect all 4/8/16 AHB address/data beats in order.
If all AXI address attributes are constant, emit one matching INCR/WRAP AXI burst; otherwise emit ordered AXI single-beat writes.
Keep Device-E and non-bufferable writes as single AXI writes.

rules.condition: Earlier safely buffered Normal Write-back beats
rules.statement: Earlier safely buffered Normal Write-back beats may complete OKAY.

rules.condition: Terminal AHB beat of buffered write burst
rules.statement: The terminal AHB beat waits for the required B response(s).
Assert WLAST only on the last W beat, wait for BRESP, and apply the response to the final AHB beat.
AHB and AXI interface signals are sampled or driven relative to the rising edge of i_clk_core.
No AXI read address is issued before the corresponding AHB read address is accepted.
AHB and AXI transaction order is preserved, with no read speculation or response reordering.

rules.condition: AXI VALID asserted and READY not yet high
rules.statement: AXI VALID and payload remain stable until the READY handshake.

rules.condition: AHB fixed write burst not completely captured
rules.statement: An AXI burst is issued only when the complete AHB fixed write burst has been captured.
At most one read and one write transaction are outstanding; a later AHB transaction must not pass a stalled response.
WLAST is high exactly on the final AXI W beat; read ARLEN is always zero and expected RLAST is one.
